China Study Services

Full Scholarships

Chinese Government Scholarships covering tuition, accommodation, and monthly stipend.

University Admission

Helping you secure admission to prestigious Chinese universities.

Student Visa

Post-Arrival Services

Supporting your integration and adaptation in China.

Turkey Study Services

Discounted Scholarships

Guaranteed Admission

Guaranteed acceptance at partner universities.

Student Residence Permit

Assistance in obtaining student residence permit.

Student Housing

Arranging accommodation in university or private dormitories.

Leading Chinese Universities

Discover some of the top universities we partner with.

Peking University

One of China's oldest and most prestigious universities, renowned for academic excellence.

Tsinghua University

Leading in science, technology, and engineering, known for advanced research programs.

Fudan University

A comprehensive research university located in Shanghai with a strong international reputation.

Zhejiang University

A prestigious university with a long history in education and scientific research.

Shanghai Jiao Tong University

A leading university in engineering, medicine, and business administration.

And Many More

We partner with over 50 top universities across China and Turkey.

Contact Us

Why Choose Our Services?

We are committed to providing the best services to ensure the success of your educational journey.

Experience

From application to graduation, we're with you every step of the way.

Transparency

Specialized Team
